name: Bermuda

flag.description: A red field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist and, in the fly, the coat of arms of Bermuda: a red lion holding a shield that shows the wreck of a sailing ship on the rocks.
flag.symbolism: The shield shows the wreck of the Sea Venture on Bermuda's reefs in 1609, which led to the islands' settlement by the English.

hook: Bermuda is the British territory in red: a Red Ensign with a lion holding a shipwreck, where its Caribbean cousins fly blue.
trivia: Bermuda is the only British Overseas Territory to use a Red Ensign, rather than a Blue Ensign, as its main flag.
The wreck of the Sea Venture shown on the flag is thought to have inspired Shakespeare's The Tempest.
